title: Adaptive-runtime send-composition offline performance characterization
purpose: Authorize and govern one bounded offline performance characterization of the reviewed send_composition family while keeping production actuation, active_internal, CI, push, and unrelated axes outside the authority boundary.
scope: The specification applies only to the four configured cells formed by application_send_batch_formation values legacy_current and single_eligible and buffer_copy_coalescing values legacy_current and memory_conservative. It governs a clean committed binary, local host, production loopback mechanism seams, immutable campaign evidence, blocked factorial analysis, held-out selector assessment, and an optional deterministic shadow recommendation.

requirements.title: Authorize only the reviewed offline four-cell family
requirements.statement: The repository MUST authorize offline performance measurement only for the four configured send_composition cells built from application_send_batch_formation values legacy_current and single_eligible and buffer_copy_coalescing values legacy_current and memory_conservative; require the two exact reviewed actuation proofs, the passed correctness interaction review, a clean committed source tree, exact binary and host identity, false active behavior authorization, false production activation, false performance acceptance authorization, and every outside axis at legacy_current; and deny ordinary production configuration, active_internal, another axis, a stale manifest, or a mismatched runtime cell.
notes: Measurement authorization is distinct from performance acceptance and production activation.
The authorization carrier is internal and fixed-field.

requirements.title: Compile and execute a deterministic production-seam campaign
requirements.statement: The send-composition performance runner MUST execute serial randomized or counterbalanced blocks through the production QUIC application-send scheduler, buffer-coalescing, owner, and terminal-release seams; freeze and hash source and binaries; fingerprint the host; retain exact configured and effective cell identity, workload context, treatment order, seed, warmup, duration, repetitions, correctness gates, runtime evidence aggregates, raw outcomes, and checksums; classify every run; and exclude inactive, fallback-dominated, incorrect, identity-mismatched, or environment-invalid runs from performance conclusions without deleting them.
notes: Workload identity is offline context and is not a runtime controller input.
Large matrices and concurrent treatment execution remain prohibited.

requirements.title: Classify configured and effective send-composition cells truthfully
requirements.statement: Campaign validation MUST derive activation and effective signatures from runtime mechanism evidence; require batch activation for single_eligible comparisons and buffer activation for memory_conservative comparisons when the upstream batch remains legacy_current; record that single_eligible supplies one selected write and therefore makes the downstream buffer-coalescing distinct predicate structurally inactive on that send opportunity; retain all four configured cells while treating configured cells with the same effective signature as expected-equivalent; and prohibit performance claims for missing or incorrectly attributed activation.
notes: The D configured cell is expected-equivalent to B at the mechanism layer when single_eligible actuates.
The campaign therefore characterizes four configured cells and three reachable primary effective signatures.

requirements.title: Analyze effects and guardrails reproducibly
requirements.statement: Offline analysis MUST use the predeclared blocked design, deterministic train and holdout split, effect sizes, confidence intervals, practical significance thresholds, and multiplicity-aware metric interpretation; report batch, buffer, configured interaction, and context effects without averaging away regimes; retain throughput, completion latency, CPU, allocation, copy, retained-memory, fairness, fallback, inactivity, and correctness guardrails where observed; and distinguish uncertain, trivial, workload-specific, broadly generalizable, guardrail-violating, dominated, and structurally equivalent results.
notes: A p-value alone is not an acceptance rule.
Structurally inactive D-cell buffer behavior is not an observed buffer treatment.

requirements.title: Permit only reproducible shadow selection
requirements.statement: Selector analysis MUST use only bounded legitimate runtime observations, exclude workload, scenario, benchmark, host, peer, URL, and application identity, prevent run and repetition leakage, evaluate held-out regret and guardrails, implement a compact deterministic shadow-only rule only when predeclared practical benefit and held-out stability gates pass, otherwise emit no_stable_rule or more_context_required, and ensure any shadow recommendation preserves the configured applied behavior, carries a versioned rule and evidence hash, requires no runtime model loading or unbounded state, and remains independently reproducible and rollbackable.
notes: No selector is preferable to a speculative selector.

requirements.title: Close the milestone with preserved repository and evidence authority
requirements.statement: The milestone MUST preserve the complete accepted correctness ancestry and coherent local work in clean local main; retain recoverable pre-consolidation patches, files, and Git bundle; remove only merged obsolete adaptive-runtime worktrees and branches; keep unrelated unique branches; validate prior correctness regressions, the campaign, analysis, held-out result, direct SpecTrace artifacts, focused Release builds, and diff checks; retain large raw evidence outside Git with checksum inventories; create an exact final Git archive and bundle; and finish with one clean main worktree, no push, no CI modification, no active_internal, and no production activation.
notes: The preserved ACK Stage 5 draft remains outside this measurement slice.
Remote branches are not deleted and nothing is pushed.
